verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, either as a batch API endpoint or as a multi-select bulk action in the UI. The API endpoints shown (list, cancel, create, update, duplicate) all act on one item at a time; looping over them is only a developer building block. Attaching a workflow to one or more links, or auto-attaching it to new links, is an adjacent feature rather than general bulk operations across many items.
